title: Weight Docket Maker
description: A full-stack application for managing weight dockets and invoices, featuring automated background printing, email integration, and PDF report generation.
Highlights: Automated cross-platform printing service supporting both Windows and Unix spooling pipelines
Dynamic HTML-to-PDF invoice and weight docket generation powered by WeasyPrint and Jinja2 templating
Automated background database backup scheduler with integrated Google Drive cloud synchronization
Robust relational data architecture with PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy ORM, and Alembic database versioning
Comprehensive SMTP email delivery service with customizable notification templates and attachments
